verdict.rationale: Convex ships a first-party `npx convex export` command that exports deployment data to a ZIP file, and its docs list data Import & Export interoperability. The open-source backend can also be self-hosted with the same code as the cloud service, giving a real exit path from the hosted platform. missing for 10: documentation of the file formats inside the ZIP (e.g. JSON/CSV), explicit confirmation that exports cover all data including file storage, independent or hands-on corroboration of a full export-and-migrate workflow.
